capabilities: Sync the file modification time into a frontmatter property on save
Set the creation time property for new files
Customize the date format and property key names
Support string and number (Unix timestamp) property types
extras: The README warns users to back up their vault because the plugin modifies files; it also notes that external file changes update the properties since it reads times from the filesystem.
problem: Obsidian tracks file modification and creation times on the filesystem but does not keep them as note properties that can be sorted, queried or displayed.
summary: Property updater that writes the file's last-modified and creation times into frontmatter properties on save.
